❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Scientific vs engineering notation?
Scientific keeps 1 ≤ a < 10; engineering forces the exponent to a multiple of 3, matching SI prefixes like kilo and mega.
How do I read 2.5 × 10^-4?
Move the decimal point 4 places left: 0.00025.
Why is the exponent negative for small numbers?
Each leftward decimal shift divides by 10, so a number like 0.003 needs 10^-3 to scale back up.
